# KaTeX 0.19.0

Bundled from the official npm package `katex@0.19.0` (2026-10-02).
Includes the minified renderer, auto-render extension, CSS and original fonts.
MIT license included as LICENSE. No CDN or external runtime requests.

Content uses explicit `\(...\)` inline and `\[...\]` display delimiters.
Rendering uses `trust: false`, strict parsing and HTML plus accessible MathML.
The server permits inline style attributes for mathematical layout while
keeping scripts and stylesheet files restricted to this local origin.
